subject: Request for per-token usage export + commit tier alignment
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@fintera.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Fintera: request for token-level export + commit discount alignment

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency looked solid. Procurement has asked for a more detailed billing export so we can map our internal cost analytics to Redwood line items. Specifically we need: 

- Daily token-level CSV for the last 12 months (model name, request direction i.e. prompt/response, tokens_in, tokens_out, timestamp, route/id)
- Separate totals by model variant (e.g., gpt-large-q4_0) and a high-level monthly summary
- Any existing mapping of your invoice line items to the token categories you use (generation vs embedding vs other)

We're also trying to understand what commit tiers would look like for us. Our finance team is targeting an effective price of ~$0.0006 per token at scale (post-discount) and wants 3 commit options to present internally: conservative, expected, and aggressive. Can you provide suggested commit levels and corresponding per-token discounts and the minimum terms?

If it helps, we can accept a CSV template you provide — procurement prefers a machine-readable dump rather than screenshots. Can you share that and a short note on what normalized fields mean?

Would appreciate if you can get something to us by end of next week (Aug 28).

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Director, ML Ops
Fintera Analytics

Subject: Re: Fintera: request for token-level export + commit discount alignment

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. Attaching a CSV template and a draft of commit tiers so your procurement team can start mapping. Quick notes:

- The CSV template (usage_export_template.csv) includes: utc_timestamp, request_id, model_variant, direction (prompt/response), tokens_in, tokens_out, account_id (anonymized), and invoice_line_key.
- invoice_line_key is Redwood's internal mapping that appears on invoices; it allows direct reconciliation to line items.
- For monthly rollups we include model_variant and total_tokens columns.

I've looped in Marissa (pricing) and Vivek (sales leadership) to weigh in on discounting.

Next steps: if you confirm the format we'll produce a 12-month dump in the CSV and a short README explaining each column. I can also set a 30-minute call Wed Aug 28 at 10am PT to walk procurement through the file and the proposed tiers. Does that time work?

Attachments: usage_export_template.csv, draft_commit_options.xlsx

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@fintera.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintera: request for token-level export + commit discount alignment

Elena / Hannah — looping in a concise pricing proposal so procurement has concrete options. High-level assumptions: 30-day billing, hosted API, per-token metering (generation tokens count), invoiced monthly. Examples below use effective per-token rates after the indicated tier discount.

Suggested commit schedule (examples):
- Conservative (pilot): 1M tokens/month => no commit, standard list pricing (no discount) or a one-time pilot credit if agreed (term: 1 month)
- Expected: 10M tokens/month => 12-month commit => 10% discount => effective price: $0.0009/token
- Aggressive: 100M tokens/month => 12-month commit => 35% discount => effective price: $0.00052/token

Notes and constraints:
- Discounts above assume hosted API only and require a 12-month minimum for tiered pricing (shorter terms get reduced discounts).
- We can structure monthly consumption commits as a sustained-usage credit rather than itemized pre-payment; credits roll forward for billing reconciliation within the contract term.
- Procurement items we typically require: signed SOW or contract addendum, SOC2 attestation, and a statement of expected average monthly usage (for capacity planning).

I attached the pricing_calcs_08-24.pdf that shows the math and an example invoice line mapping. If Fintera is targeting ~$0.0006/token effective, the aggressive tier at ~100M/month gets close, but we should confirm model mix (embeddings vs generation) because embeddings are billed differently.

Hannah — if you can confirm their 3-month ramp expectations, I can draft the official proposal and list the procurement doc checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_calcs_08-24.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@fintera.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fintera: request for token-level export + commit discount alignment

Thanks team — quick follow-up from leadership. I'm comfortable approving a limited-time onboarding concession:

- A one-time invoice credit equal to 10% of the first month’s billed usage if Fintera signs a 12-month expected-tier commit within 30 days.
- We will treat the pilot month as billable at list, then apply the credit on the next invoice (this avoids revenue recognition complexity).

Hannah — please capture Fintera's estimated month 1/3/6 volumes in the HubSpot record HS-34217 and share the signed commitment by Sep 24 to qualify. Marissa — if they accept, we can include the credit clause in the contract addendum.

Vivek
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
